remarks: TOO GOOD TO BE TRUE! Once you turn the bend on Harbor Road it is like a retreat in the fabulous town of Westport!  This gorgeous 3 bedroom, 2.1 bath with a sleeping loft is relaxing in a gorgeous beach community. If you always wanted to try beach living this is the place for you. The entire house is sun-drenched and has water views from almost every room! This home also boasts a stone patio and outdoor fireplace for family and friends to gather. Saugatuck Shores beach community is a fun and friendly neighborhood. -- The property is close to Saugatuck Rowing Club which has a beautiful fitness facility and restaurant. It is super easy to commute from the train station away from the traffic. Close proximity to other fabulous restaurants like Tarantino's, Gabriele's and The Whelk to name a few. Best of all is this home has front row seating on an amazing deck overlooking the water to the 4th of July fireworks celebration. - Imagine waking up to a full view of the sunrise every morning! Come and take a walk along the sound with a beautiful view of the lighthouse and relax and the beach. A moment of zen in the heart of Westport Connecticut!
